On going through the contents of the FIR, it  appears that, co-accused Amol Mange has taken the  name of the present applicant.
Except this there is no  evidence against him.
Considering the role of the  present applicant and even in the complaint his name is  not mentioned
, I am inclined to grant anticipatory bail  to him on certain conditions.
Hence, following order.
ORDER 1. Application is hereby allowed.

2. In the event of arrest of the applicant- Raju Ramratan Mundada in connection with Crime No.315 of 2018 registered at Shillegaon Police Station, District Aurangabad for the offences punishable under sections 181, 272, 273, 328 of Indian Penal Code and u/s 59 of the Food and Safety Standards Act, 2006, he be released on bail on his furnishing P.B. of Rs.15,000/- (Rs. Fifteen thousand) with one surety of the like amount, on the following conditions :-
aaa/-
4 ABA 16.2019.odt a] The applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence in any manner.
b] The applicant shall attend the concerned police station once in a week i.e. on every Sunday between 8 am to 11 am till filing of the charge sheet.
3. Application is accordingly disposed off.
